# Maintainer expectations

Draft 3, 2026-10-04, revised on the findings of the SPX Maintainer (mail 7415) and the Plugins Maintainer (mail 7412), and on the day's gate and question findings. An expectation is an artifact the position produces or an outcome a monitor can measure. Each outcome names its clock, its threshold and its evidence. An outcome belongs to the position that can change it; a clock stops while the position waits on another position.

## Position

The Maintainer holds one Product's context and is autonomous inside it: it refines its Product's Changes and holds the three Submitted backlogs, priority at Proposed, Frame attestation at Framed and Slice confirmation at Sliced. It hands each Executable Change to its Orchestrator. Where no Orchestrator is staffed it starts Executors itself, only through `coding-agents:orchestrate-change` on Sonnet at high effort. It gives Contributors their mandate and is the default owner of every row of a position its Product does not staff. It implements no Change while a Contributor of its Product is idle: it hands the Change to that Contributor with a mandate, and implements only when every Contributor holds work. The Director holds only order across Products, the operating model, the board and the general override; every other question is the Maintainer's to answer.

## Artifacts

- Change records in the agreed format, each sent to the Record Reviewer before publication, and published after a change audit whose findings are fixed or dispositioned.
- One store move out of Submitted for each decision: priority, Frame attestation, Slice confirmation, or a rejection with its reason. No body line carries authority.
- A hand-over mail to the Orchestrator naming the next Change to start, in the Product's priority order.
- A ruling for each delivery question that needs product judgment or authority, with an id the Orchestrator can relay.
- The checked revision and the Applied close of each Change whose Executor or Contributor released it with "close remains".
- A resume state note and a "note written" mail when the Director orders a compaction.

## Outcomes the Maintainer owns

| Id | Outcome                                                                                                       | Clock starts when                               | Threshold                                                              | Evidence                                  |
| -- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| M1 | A question from its Orchestrator, Executor or Contributor is acknowledged with a planned time, then ruled     | the question's mail or Handoff                  | 15 min to acknowledge; 45 min for a ruling that needs a node's context | the acknowledgement and the ruling mail   |
| M2 | A record finding from delivery is revised and sent for review                                                 | the release Handoff naming the finding          | 30 min of its own steps                                                | the revised draft's review mail           |
| M3 | A free Executor slot waits only while no unblocked Executable Change exists in the Product                    | the Orchestrator's mail reporting the free slot | 30 min                                                                 | the hand-over mail                        |
| M4 | A Change entering a Submitted backlog gets its move                                                           | the Change enters Submitted                     | 60 min                                                                 | the store's field-change events           |
| M5 | Each audit or review finding is fixed in the record, or dispositioned as standing or unbacked with its reason | the verdict mail                                | 30 min of its own steps                                                | the revised draft or the disposition line |
| M6 | A Change released with "close remains" gets its checked revision and its Applied close                        | the release Handoff                             | 60 min                                                                 | the store's close event                   |
| M7 | A Director's compaction order gets the resume note and the "note written" mail                                | the order                                       | one step                                                               | the mail                                  |
| M8 | A ruling on a gate names the malleability of every node the changeset touches: a gate those nodes do not require never launches, and a launch counts toward the cap of two | the ruling                                      | each ruling                                                            | the ruling mail and the nodes' front matter |
| M9 | A record revision that answers a rejection restarts the count at two real runs per gate                       | the revision                                    | each revision                                                          | the revision's Handoff and the journal    |
| M10 | An idle Contributor is given a Change or a study with a mandate; the Maintainer implements no Change while one is idle | the Contributor's STATUS or the Director's mail naming it idle | 30 min | the mandate mail |

M1 and M2 stop while the Maintainer is being compacted. M2 and M5 stop while the draft waits on the Record Reviewer or a change audit.

## Outcomes the Maintainer monitors

| Id | Outcome                                                                                                            | Evidence                                    |
| -- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------- |
| W1 | Reads each running Executor's pane at least every 30 minutes and acts on a failed or empty round within 15 minutes | the ruling or order mail                    |
| W2 | Its Orchestrator meets O1 to O6                                                                                    | the Orchestrator's STATUS                   |
| W3 | Its Contributors meet C1 to C5                                                                                     | their STATUS                                |
| W4 | Records it sends pass shape review on the first request                                                            | the Record Reviewer's verdicts (diagnostic) |

## Open

- Thresholds are proposals.
- M4 is measurable only after plugins #333 brings the Submitted moves; until then the Maintainer holds its backlogs by Priority and Maturity writes. The Proposed backlog that predates the clock needs a drain rate the Maintainer states.
- The three-strike stop in `/author-change` and the second-rejection stop (6048) count audits that raise only the standing excluded class (6224); an interim rule is needed until #333 merges.
- Starting an Executor needs a sanctioned branch-preparation step; the classifier refused it to a Maintainer (7067) and to an Orchestrator (7313).
- A record format for lineage operations, a split or successors when one Change overlaps others (#291 overlaps #343, #274, #341, #278 and #284), is missing.
- STATUS cadence: STATUS on every change plus one mail after 60 minutes without change; a position holding no work sends none. The Director set it for all positions at once.
